waivers.reason: Second and last waiver on this branch, and the debt now has a ledger id rather than a promise: GAP-041, opened by this release, states what is unmeasured and names the round that closes it. This release adds no code — it writes down a boundary five earlier releases moved — so a round driven for it would measure nothing this release changed. The round is the next and final stage of specs/2026-08-26-board-refresh-design.md, and it is what closes GAP-041.
